notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.002
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here is the first round of patches. 
Thank you for your feedback and support so for, its been a crazy day!

-Fixed storage item disapperance
-Decreased Rhinowing(flying red enemies) spawn count
-Increased starting hp from 50=>60 for Strider. and 40=>50 for Brute and Spectre
-Increased Mecha Experience gain after the runs.
-Decreased Yabi's and Jaya's projectile damage.
-Decreased level up screen flash animations brightness
-Mostly working on fixing the crashes right now. This patch might lower the probabilty of them but it takes a bit time to eliminate them completely.
Meanwhile it would be really hepfull if you can send me your crash reports to this email => info@massivehug.xyz
Users\[username]\AppData\Local\Temp\Massive Hug\Demon Hunt\Crashes

I'm aware of the issues about recycling/upgrading items. I'll fix them next.
And if you enjoy the game, dropping a review would be really hepfull.
Thank you for your patience and sorry for the issues

notes.title: Demo Update 0.17.005
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here are some updates to the demo!

-Added Offerings, Soulstones and Pylons. These new PoI's allows you to spawn more elite demons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094603/bd1050a9f377bfd9e2eb91b6d2a09e17e8ddde41.png[/img]

-Updated core visuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094603/562831be0074a47b1161c3b0fb3d9804b5f67f2e.png[/img]

-Updated settings UI and added a minimap distance option.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094603/a1d2257cb81c03e07ecead37d811a924245ccd44.png[/img]

-Added icons on the minimap for the PoI's, They become visible as you discover them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094603/755a1a681392115d1d6d3d5da4e28baa326273fa.png[/img]

-Updated weapon visuals for dualsaber and orbiter.
-Reduced the number of shrines spawned on the map.
-Flying demons(projectile-shooting) now have more health.
-Ion Mortar balance: Reduced Ion Ring damage overall.
-Minigun balance: Increased damage overall and increased volatile blast radius.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.17.003
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
Here is the first update to the demo, featuring some visual improvements and QoL changes.
Thank you all for your feedback! I'm reading all of it, so please keep it coming! 😊

-Updated most enemy models.
-Improved the level-up screen and item panels.
-Enhanced the overall environment, including visuals and colors.
-Added buttons to the recycle screen for quickly adding items in bulk.
-Added equipped item slots to the item upgrade screen.
-The highest-level token is now auto-inserted in the unique/set item crafting screen.
-Items are now auto-equipped if the corresponding slot is empty.
-Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when exiting.
-Fixed a bug that allowed set and unique items to be upgraded without the required currency.
-Fixed a bug that prevented level 10 items from having their rarity upgraded.
